question: What public reset-start config contract should OpenClaw support for prompt text customization across root session config, per-agent overrides, bootstrap-aware prompts, and acknowledgement-only reset behavior?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive config surface that changes fresh-session prompt semantics, and automation should not choose a competing key or accidentally bypass bootstrap/current-time safeguards.

options.title: Choose one reset-start policy
options.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to prompt text only
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving the current default and documenting how bootstrap/current-time prompt parts are handled.

options.title: Defer to broader reset greeting work
options.body: Keep this issue open but route the config choice through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12931 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77733 first.

recommendation.title: Choose one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly intersects the startup-context and bootstrap-aware reset prompt work this owner recently carried.
